text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day—a mountain of fan letters arrived 
for Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...! Is all of this... for me...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
GlÃ¼cklich... I'm so very happy. I wish I 
could show this to my parents, too...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I absolutely must send a reply in 
return."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Under a flawless schedule... I shall 
write a sincere reply to each and every 
letter.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? You're eating really fast today, 
aren't you, Flash?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because, if we make good use of this 
time—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's—oh, right! You did say you were 
going to write replies to your fan 
letters.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I've been cheering for you since your 
debut—" ...My! Has this person really 
watched every single one of my races up 
until now?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“How truly grateful I am. I will continue 
to be an Umamusume worthy of your 
support.”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, goodness. Saying it here won't 
reach them. I must make sure to pour all 
my gratitude into my reply."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"—Now then, Falcon-san. Please solve this 
problem using this equation. You have a 
time limit of 15 minutes."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then. If you'll excuse me, I shall 
take a moment to read it."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: E-Even while studying?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...! This letter is in German. Could it be 
from someone visiting Japan from my 
homeland?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"‘As a fellow local, your running makes me 
so proud—’ Hehe. What an honor..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“—And so... man, Flash-san is incredible! 
She managed to write the whole thing in 
just one week!”
choice_data_list:
Well... actually, this morning, it 
happened again—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Again?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. Could it be that what's 
inside that cardboard box you've been 
carrying this whole time is—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...N-No way!? Are all of these fan 
letters!?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...There are so many people paying 
attention to my running..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Amaaazing! I'm so glad for you, Flash-san!
choice_data_list:
Are you going to reply to all of these 
too?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Of course. There is no way the goodwill 
from my fans could ever be a burden.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"The fan letters I received the other 
day... Every single one truly conveyed 
everyone's warm feelings."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I want to return the exact same feelings 
to those who gave to me— That is my 
heartfelt wish right now.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... As expected of Flash-san! There are 
tons of points for an Umadol to learn from 
here!
